purpose: Implement pure PM Return replay and receipt validation decisions from immutable server observations; preserve original committed receipt and fail closed on unresolved journal states.
publication_policy: Parent sole publisher; isolated worker; independent review and exact-head/base CI.
sql_policy: No SQL connection/execution, schema/data changes or durability claim.
constraints: Only listed new files after remote admission
No shared v1, Audit P01, API, DI, capability or readiness edits
Opaque configured database binding; no secret-derived identity
Unknown, in-progress and tombstone never permit dispatch
Replay preserves original committed receipt and fingerprint
No empty gateway interfaces or in-memory durability claims
Real storage, atomicity, reconciliation and ABA remain gated
